svg.title: The hold band
svg.desc: Animated. Left, an elevator carriage on rails with a green volts arrow pushing up and gravity pulling down. Right, a volts line from 0 V to more volts with a shaded band: left of it the carriage slides down, inside it friction holds it still, right of it the carriage creeps up. A green marker for the volts we apply moves along the line: inside the band the carriage stays still; past the upper edge it creeps up; below the lower edge it slides down. Brackets show that from 0 V to the middle of the band is gravity (kG) and half the band's width is friction (kS).
svg.text: In the band between sliding down and creeping up, friction holds it still.
The middle of the band is gravity (kG); half its width is friction (kS).
